svg.title: capability-gate Level 1: inside Gate.evaluate()
svg.text: capability_gate.py · checks run top to bottom; the first failure denies
A failed check exits right as DENY. In enforce a tamper or a failed write leaves no row.
halt marker present, or its state unreadable
log folder removed or replaced; no writable halt spot
kill switch thrown: … a human removes it
a tool path names the switch, the log, its
witness or anchor, or the checkpoint folder
path '…' is the kill switch marker
path '…' is the audit log anchor
set by the hook: arguments unreadable, or a
write aimed at the gate's own files
relative path with no base folder
relative path '…' has no base folder
skill must be granted; tool must be granted to it
path '…' is a canary secret inside a grant
resolved path must match a granted glob;
a folder must not reach outside it
tool needs a human: verdict is ASK
ASK: both hooks block it today
observe records the true verdict and acts on nothing
one hash-chained row, fsync, before the hook acts
